reviewer: Claude coordinator and independent Claude review agents (text, illustrations)
text: Independent review agent read the full text against Ryder's The Shrewd Old Gander and its lead-in; the frame is stated correctly: inside The Plover Who Fought the Ocean, which Victor tells Lively, a bird tells this tale to the flock. The frame and the Garuda sequel are omitted with disclosure.
Every plot step of the source is kept; 'We are all lost now' is softened to 'great danger', and the additions are disclosed.
Age band 8+: there is a threat of being killed and the geese are thrown from the tree, but nobody is hurt; the content note says the geese pretend to be dead.
The ಬಲೆ vocabulary meaning was corrected before approval. Birds in the neuter; no em dashes.
illustrations: Storyboard 1024x1536, under 650 KB; seams exactly at x=512 and y=512/1024; no gutters, lines, vignettes or text.
Six panels follow the banyan tree, the growing vine, the hunter's net, the night in the net, the geese lying still on the grass and the flock's escape.

In panel 5 the geese rest upright on their bellies with eyes closed, so they read as pretending, not dead; the hunter holds one goose gently upright (one edit pass replaced a limp dangling goose, composited back on the grid and disclosed).
Nothing violent is drawn; the hunter wears a dhoti and a wide shawl, with no caste markers or modern objects.
Accepted minor issue: the number of geese drifts slightly between panels.
limitations: AI-agent editorial review, not human Kannada-teacher or scholar certification.
Age bands are editorial judgements against the README table and have not been tested with children or parents.
Source fidelity was checked against saved copies of the Wikisource pages of Ryder's 1925 translation, not against Durgasimha's Kannada text or a Sanskrit recension.

Art was generated with Codex CLI on gpt-5.6-sol because gpt-6.1-sol is not available to this ChatGPT-linked account; it was judged on the full sheet and 512px panel crops with the grid measured in pixels, not in the app in dark mode.
